about.title: About
about.intro: Western Legends Companion is an unofficial, fan-made companion app created to add dynamic events, story encounters, setup guidance, quick references, and table-side tools to Western Legends.
about.creator: Created and developed by Randy Dykstra for the Western Legends community.
about.support: If it has earned a place at your table, a small tip helps support continued development, new features, and future frontier tales.
about.disclaimer: Western Legends and its related expansions belong to their respective owners. Western Legends Companion is an independent fan project and is not an official product of the publisher.
about.contactCopy: Found a bug, have a suggestion, or spotted a rules correction? I’d be glad to hear from you.

leads: The dust settled soft over Darkrock and Red Falls, with few tales fit for ink before the presses rolled.
For once the territory kept its business to itself, and the Gazette’s runners came back with empty notebooks.
quiet.sectionIntro: What little did cross the wire is recorded plainly below, for whatever it’s worth:
closings: The frontier held its breath - no notable deeds crossed the Companion’s ledger before the presses rolled, and Darkrock slept easy for once.
Not a single wire came in from the range today. Some say a quiet frontier is a lucky one; others say it just means the trouble hasn’t been caught yet.

leads: Honest folk kept one eye on their wallets and the other on the road as lawless deeds stirred the territory from sunup to sundown.
Word from every stagecoach and saloon agrees: the wanted rode bolder this week than the marshals could answer.
lawless.sectionIntro: The wanted made their mark from one end of the territory to the other:
closings: Outlaws rode wilder than the law could answer this time - prospectors panned nervous and merchants counted their tills twice, for the wanted held the upper hand across the territory.
The wanted ledger grew fat and the marshals grew thin trying to keep pace - it was, by any honest account, a lawless season out here.

headlines: A Firm Hand on the Territory
leads: Badges outnumbered bandits at every turn this week, and the territory was all the calmer for it.
From the Sheriff’s office to the farthest ranch, word travels that the law is riding tall and the wanted are riding careful.
orderly.sectionIntro: The marshals kept a full ledger of their own this week:
closings: The marshals kept a tight rein on the territory - wanted men rode careful and quiet, and honest prospectors and shopkeepers turned a fine profit under a watchful, orderly sky.
Law and order carried the day from start to finish - the badges outpaced the bandits at every turn, and the territory prospered for it.

leads: For every robbery answered by an arrest, some fresh mischief rose up to take its place, and the territory stayed exactly as tense as the old-timers like it.
Neither badge nor bandit could claim the upper hand this week - a seesaw of trouble and order that kept every saloon conversation lively.
tense.sectionIntro: Both sides of the law had their say this week:
closings: It was a fair fight between outlaw and lawman all season - for every robbery answered by an arrest, some fresh mischief rose to take its place, and the territory stayed exactly as tense as the old-timers like it.
Neither the wanted nor the marshals ever quite gained the upper hand - a seesaw of trouble and order that kept every saloon conversation lively.

leads: From dusty mines to crowded card tables, the frontier offered opportunity to anyone bold enough to reach for it.
Prospectors, gamblers, and shopkeepers alike found the territory generous this week, with fortune favoring the industrious over the infamous.
opportunity.sectionIntro: Enterprise, not outlawry, carried the territory this week:
closings: The territory saw its share of both trouble and order, but mostly it saw opportunity - gold panned, cards played, and deals struck under a fair frontier sky.
A little lawlessness, a little justice, and a whole lot of honest hustle filled out the day, the way it usually goes out here when the range is generous.

leads: Fists and firearms settled more arguments than words this week, and the Gazette struggled to keep the tally of split lips and spent cartridges straight.
Whatever else happened out on the range, the territory will remember this as the week when every disagreement seemed to end in a fight.
bloodshed.sectionIntro: Reports of fights - won, lost, and everything between - poured into the Gazette office:
closings: Whether it was over cards, cattle, or plain old grudges, the territory settled its business with fists and fight cards more often than words this week.
Some weeks the frontier talks its way through trouble. This wasn’t one of them - the fight cards did most of the talking instead.

strings.take_a_gamble_action_while_adjacent_to_a: Take a Gamble action while adjacent to a Saloon. Any other player in the same town may join. If at least one other player joins, the active player gains $10. The dealer is the closest non-participating player to the right of the active player; if everyone joins, the active player is the dealer.
strings.draw_4_fight_cards_show_3_and_keep_1_fac: Draw 4 Fight Cards; show 3 and keep 1 facedown
strings.the_dealer_draws_the_top_4_fight_cards_r: The dealer draws the top 4 Fight Cards. Reveal the first 3 to all players and leave the fourth card facedown.
strings.place_up_to_2_bets_of_10_or_20_active_pl: Place up to 2 bets of $10 or $20; active player bets last
strings.in_clockwise_order_with_the_active_playe: In clockwise order, with the active player placing the last bet, each player may place up to 2 bet markers on the Faro board. Each marker is $10 or $20. Your two markers cannot be on the same card value, and your total bets cannot exceed the money you currently have.
strings.shuffle_the_4_cards_first_reveal_loses: Shuffle the 4 cards; first reveal loses
strings.the_dealer_shuffles_all_4_cards_facedown: The dealer shuffles all 4 cards facedown and offers the active player a cut. Reveal the top card as the Loser. Every bet on that card value loses: pay the amount on that marker to the supply and reclaim the marker.
strings.second_reveal_pays_1_1_1_gp_decide_wheth: Second reveal pays 1:1 + 1 GP; decide whether to press on
strings.reveal_the_next_card_as_the_winner_match: Reveal the next card as the Winner. Matching bets pay 1:1: gain money equal to the marker and 1 Gambler Point, then reclaim that marker. Starting to the left of the active player, anyone with a marker still on the board must either reclaim it and stop or leave it for the Jackpot round.
strings.third_reveal_pays_3_1_1_gp_all_other_rem: Third reveal pays 3:1 + 1 GP; all other remaining bets lose
strings.reveal_the_next_card_as_the_jackpot_matc: Reveal the next card as the Jackpot. Matching bets gain 3 times the marker value and 1 Gambler Point, then reclaim the marker. Every other marker still on the board loses: pay its value to the supply and reclaim it. Shuffle all Fight Cards used in Faro and place them on the bottom of the Fight deck.
strings.need_at_least_30_1_poker_card_ante_10_an: Need at least $30 + 1 Poker Card; ante $10 and draw 1
strings.to_initiate_high_stakes_poker_the_active: To initiate High Stakes Poker, the active player must have at least $30 and 1 Poker Card. Take a Gamble action while adjacent to a Saloon, pay $10 to the pot, and draw 1 Poker Card.
strings.same_town_players_may_join_in_clockwise_: Same-town players may join in clockwise order
strings.each_other_player_in_the_same_town_decid: Each other player in the same town decides in clockwise order whether to join. To join, a player must have at least $30 and 1 Poker Card; they pay $10 to the pot and draw 1 Poker Card.
strings.saloon_adds_40_if_solo_dealer_draws_5_ca: Saloon adds $40; if solo, dealer draws 5 cards
strings.the_saloon_adds_40_to_the_pot_if_no_othe: The Saloon adds $40 to the pot. If no other player joined, the player to the right of the active player becomes the dealer, sets aside their normal hand, and draws 5 Poker Cards for this game.
strings.reveal_3_communal_poker_cards_faceup_the: Reveal 3 communal Poker Cards faceup. These are the flop.
strings.players_act_clockwise_from_the_active_pl: Players act clockwise from the active player’s left; dealer never folds
strings.starting_with_the_player_to_the_left_of_: Starting with the player to the left of the active player and proceeding clockwise, each player either adds $20 to the pot or folds. A player who folds forfeits their $10 ante, loses the game, and draws 1 Poker Card. If a dealer is playing, the dealer always adds $20 from the supply and never folds.
strings.all_fold_clear_pot_lone_player_may_win_i: All fold: clear pot; lone player may win immediately
strings.if_all_players_fold_return_all_money_in_: If all players fold, return all money in the pot to the supply. If only 1 player remains and no dealer is playing, that player immediately takes the pot and gains 1 Legendary Point and 1 Gambler Point.
strings.if_play_continues_reveal_2_more_communal: If play continues, reveal 2 more communal cards
strings.if_the_hand_continues_and_no_dealer_is_p: If the hand continues and no dealer is playing, the Saloon adds another $20 to the pot. Then reveal 2 more communal Poker Cards: the turn and river.
strings.reveal_2_hand_cards_use_any_3_communal_c: Reveal 2 hand cards + use any 3 communal cards
strings.starting_to_the_left_of_the_active_playe: Starting to the left of the active player and proceeding clockwise, each remaining player reveals 2 cards from hand and combines them with 3 of the 5 communal cards to make the best Poker hand possible. The dealer does the same when playing. Resolve Poker/Gambling abilities as in normal Poker.
strings.best_hand_wins_winner_gets_pot_1_lp_1_gp: Best hand wins; winner gets pot + 1 LP + 1 GP
strings.the_best_hand_wins_the_dealer_wins_ties_: The best hand wins. The dealer wins ties; the active player wins ties against other players. If multiple non-active players tie, each gains 1 LP and 1 GP and they split the pot evenly, rounding down; return any remainder to the supply. If the dealer wins, return the pot to the supply. Otherwise, a winning player takes the pot and gains 1 LP and 1 GP. All losers draw 1 Poker Card, and all players discard the cards they revealed.
strings.gamble_beside_a_saloon_pay_10_and_draw_1: Gamble beside a Saloon; pay $10 and draw 1 Poker Card
strings.take_a_gamble_action_while_adjacent_to_a: Take a Gamble action while adjacent to a Saloon. The active player pays $10 to the pot and draws 1 Poker Card.
strings.any_player_in_the_same_town_may_buy_in_f: Any player in the same town may buy in for $10
strings.each_other_player_in_the_same_town_may_j: Each other player in the same town may join. A joining player pays $10 to the pot and draws 1 Poker Card. After everyone has joined or passed, the house adds $50 to the pot.
strings.if_nobody_joins_the_player_to_the_right_: If nobody joins, the player to the right deals against you
strings.if_no_other_player_joined_the_player_to_: If no other player joined, the player to the right of the active player becomes the dealer. The dealer sets aside their normal Poker hand and draws 4 Poker Cards as their hand for this game.
strings.reveal_the_top_3_poker_cards_faceup_thes: Reveal the top 3 Poker Cards faceup. These communal cards are the flop.

strings.discard_down_to_hand_size_5_1_per_wound: • Discard down to hand size: 5 - 1 per wound.

strings.when_a_player_lands_on_or_passes_a_gold_: • When a player lands on or passes a Gold Nugget on the LP track, return that nugget to the supply.

strings.while_at_a_ranch_space_gain_1_facedown_c: While at a Ranch space, gain 1 facedown Cattle token if you are not already carrying one.
strings.while_inside_town_buy_any_number_of_rumo: While inside town, buy any number of Rumor Cards for $30 each. Rumor Cards are treated as $10 while in your possession.
strings.while_adjacent_to_a_saloon_where_the_hig: While adjacent to a Saloon where the High Roller token is present, initiate a game of Poker.
strings.while_at_any_location_with_a_deed_card_p: While at any location with a Deed card, pay its cost and take the Deed card.
strings.while_at_the_bank_space_sell_gold_nugget: While at the Bank space, sell Gold Nuggets. Gain $20 + 1 LP per nugget.
strings.when_your_miniature_is_on_the_board_spac: When your miniature is on the board space indicated by 3 Rumor Cards, discard those Rumor Cards and gain 3 LP, 1 random Legendary Item, and the result of 2 Prospecting Dice rolls.
strings.while_on_a_river_space_discard_1_poker_c: While on a river space, discard 1 Poker Card (J, Q, K = 10; A = 11) plus any Fish Cards (1 per card) to determine Fishing Effort. Reveal Fish Cards until their total value is at least the Fishing Effort, discarding any overage. Gain 1 LP if the total equals the Fishing Effort and you caught at least 1 Fish.
strings.while_on_a_space_with_a_frontier_token_d: While on a space with a Frontier token, discard Poker Cards from your hand with a total value greater than or equal to the Frontier token + space. Gain the reward printed on the back. J, Q, K = 10; A = 11.
strings.while_at_the_doctor_s_office_pay_10_to_l: While at the Doctor's Office, pay $10 to lose all wounds/injuries, then draw 1 Poker Card per wound.
strings.while_on_a_space_with_a_hunt_action_mark: While on a space with a Hunt Action marker, remove the marker and draw Animal Cards until one matching the marker size or a Bird is revealed. Either discard the chosen Animal Card and end the action, or discard Poker Card(s) whose total value (J, Q, K = 10; A = 11) is at least the animal's Strength. Rifle modifies the check by +/-1; Shotgun gives +2. Then place the Hunt Action marker on a new unoccupied space.
strings.prospecting_deck_whenever_your_lp_marker: Prospecting Deck: whenever your LP marker lands on or passes a Gold Nugget on the LP track, return it to the supply and reveal the next Prospecting Card, adding the designated Gold Nuggets to the indicated mines.
strings.pay_20_at_the_sheriff_marshal_office_wit: Pay $20. At the Sheriff/Marshal Office with Marshal Points, recruit a Posse; at the Outlaw Camp with Wanted Points, recruit a Gang.
strings.while_at_a_space_with_a_ruin_token_disca: While at a space with a Ruin token, discard 1 Poker Card to gain 2 SP and remove the Ruin token.
strings.while_at_the_cabaret_buy_any_number_of_f: While at the Cabaret, buy any number of faceup Theatre Cards and gain the LP indicated on them. Reveal new cards until 3 Theatre Cards are faceup again.

strings.while_in_the_same_region_as_the_travelin: While in the same region as the Traveling Trader, pay $40 to gain an item from the Trader stand. Move the Trader to a new location based on the drawn card.
strings.pay_10_to_place_your_miniature_on_the_op: Pay $10 to place your miniature on the opposite Rail Station, then continue the Move action up to your maximum movement.
strings.move_up_to_your_movement_value_the_defau: Move up to your movement value. The default movement value is 2.
